notes: Foundations — light warmup (hamstring & mobility) → activation (supine marches, seated knee lifts) → core compression intro (compression hold) → simple tuck. Keep tempo slow, focus on activation and form.
Mobility + early support — pike & hip mobility warmup → supine knee raises → tucked hollow holds → parallette support hold for straight-arm stability → seated compression pulses to finish.

Straight-leg prep + dynamic core — lying straight-leg raises and active straight-leg lifts to load hip flexors → full hollow holds → parallette tuck lifts for compression → support shrugs for strong shoulder depression.
Core endurance + control — hollow rocks warmup → mobility (pike) → both-leg seated lifts for compression strength → parallette support + tuck lifts. Keep rests moderate; emphasize control on lifts.

Compression + loaded support — compression hold warmup → seated leg extensions from tuck → parallette advanced tuck lifts and advanced tuck support → finish with hanging knee raises to overload hip flexors.

High-intensity L-sit skill day — hanging straight-leg raises → hanging L-sit holds → parallettes L-sit attempts → L-sit kickouts. Target short, high-quality attempts; focus on form and shoulder depression.

Active recovery + mobility — active pike lifts → pancake lean → full hollow hold → seated forward fold → seated compression pulses. Use this day to restore movement quality and add light compression volume.
